title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.02102v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes. The Flywheel uses these records to curate verified trajectories. For unsolved tasks, recursive self-improvement evolves reusable skills and preserves verified milestones so later attempts build on earlier progress. Staged Learning combines this experience with grounding data from the Flywheel to develop GUI competence through mid-training and long-horizon supervised fine-tuning. translated_title: NorthCUA 技术报告：通过大规模经验加速计算机使用智能体
translated_abstract: 将计算机使用智能体从单个操作扩展到复杂软件工作，需要能够将决策与完整结果关联起来的经验。我们提出 NorthCUA，一个通过大规模经验来加速计算机使用智能体的集成系统。其经验飞轮为 NorthCUA Harness 提供多样化的可执行任务，该 Harness 支持长时间交互、记录决策并检查任务结果。经验飞轮利用这些记录来筛选经过验证的轨迹。对于未解决的任务，递归自我改进会演化出可复用的技能，并保留已验证的里程碑，使后续尝试建立在之前的进展之上。分阶段学习将这种经验与来自经验飞轮的定位数据相结合，通过中期训练和长时程监督微调来培养 GUI 能力。随后，策略通过桌面与网页联合强化学习，在同一 Harness 中从新的尝试中学习，从而闭合经验与提升之间的循环。
tldr: NorthCUA 构建了经验飞轮驱动的集成系统，通过大规模验证轨迹积累、递归自我改进和分阶段学习（中期训练、长时程监督微调与桌面-网页联合强化学习），显著提升计算机使用智能体完成复杂软件任务的能力。
en_tdlr: NorthCUA presents an integrated Experience Flywheel system that accelerates computer-use agents by curating verified trajectories at scale, recursively evolving reusable skills, and combining staged learning (mid-training, long-horizon SFT, and joint desktop-web RL) to master complex software work.
